units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	For a moment, silence. And then, light. Light. Nothing but light, a light that consumes your whole world even as the tinted glass shields your eyes from all but the barest glimpse of its edges. For a handful of seconds, a time that stretches into a lifetime, your whole world is light. Then it dims by a bare margin, merely blinding instead of consuming, and you can tell there is something outside the window other than infinite light, the border where the bunker ends and the landscape begins.
